name: LedgerCopilot
description: An AI-powered personal finance app that helps you track expenses, parse bank statements, and monitor your financial health — all from your pocket.
story: Felt like something else had my pocket — money would just disappear without a trace. So I built LedgerCopilot to take back control: AI-powered expense tracking, smart bank statement parsing, and a financial health dashboard that actually tells you where your money is going.

name: MySales
description: An offline-first, privacy-respecting profit tracker built for Nigerian market traders, shop owners, and small business operators who need to know if they're making wins or losses — no internet required.
story: A rising need from Grace needing an offline, easy-to-use app to record her sales and know if she's making wins or losses. So I built MySales — no accounts, no cloud, just your data on your device. Built for the market trader who needs clarity, not complexity.

name: Watchman Hymns
description: A digital hymn book app designed to enhance worship experiences in church services.
story: A voluntary project for the Watchman Catholic Charismatic Renewal Movement — built a digital hymn book from scratch with dark mode, iPad support, and offline access so worshippers could follow along seamlessly during services. Was on the App Store until the church requested it be taken down.

name: MyCGPA
description: A user-friendly mobile app designed to help university students track and calculate their CGPA effortlessly.
story: Started as a bare React Native app in 2023 to help university students track their CGPA. Migrated the entire codebase to Expo in 2025 for better DX and OTA updates. Been solo maintaining and shipping updates ever since.
problem: Students worked out their CGPA by hand, and one wrong grade point threw the whole number off.
outcome: Students add their courses once and always know their CGPA, with any semester editable when results change.

name: JOLT
description: Host Live Trivia. Play Together. — Create quizzes, share a room code, and let everyone compete in real time on the big screen.
story: My church Streams of Joy Umuahia was holding a quiz game show on Mother's Day, and the coordination between the host and the media team was really poor. I thought to myself — there must be a better way to do this. So I built JOLT, a live trivia game platform that lets anyone create quizzes, host them from their phone, and let everyone join with a room code and play in real time on the big screen.

name: Hustle
story: My second Abia State hackathon — me and my team placed 3rd and we've been building on the idea ever since. Hustle is growing into something real.

name: MOUAU eVoting System
description: An open-source mobile voting system for hosting elections across different faculties in the university.
story: Built a complete mobile voting system during my final year project at university — designed to run real elections across different faculties. Open-sourced the entire codebase so others could learn from and build on it.

name: HafrikPlay
description: A music streaming app for an Afrobeat platform connecting emerging African artists to a global audience.
story: Built the full music streaming experience for HafrikPlay — the mobile app, web dashboard, and artist portal. Reshaping the Afrobeat scene by giving emerging African artists a real platform to reach global listeners.

name: Minimalist Weather
story: My first official mobile app — built with React Native CLI before I ever touched Expo. Simple, clean, and the project that got me hooked on mobile development.

name: Lanny WebPify
description: A lightweight microservice for converting images to WebP stickers and vice versa — extracted from a larger WhatsApp chatbot.
story: Born from Lanny, my WhatsApp chatbot that converted images to stickers and stickers back to images. When WhatsApp shipped the feature natively, I extracted and open-sourced the core conversion microservice.

name: CreditWithBleon
description: An AI-powered Telegram & WhatsApp chatbot that vends mobile data and airtime with intelligent plan recommendations.
story: Powered by an actual LLM, this chatbot handles customer authentication, recommends the best data plans, and vends airtime across Telegram and WhatsApp — real fintech infrastructure running behind a chat interface.

name: FauOnionBot
description: An enterprise-grade Telegram referral chatbot built for YouTubers and promoters to grow their channels.
story: Built an enterprise-grade referral chatbot for Telegram with Docker, Redis queues, and a MySQL backend — helping YouTubers and content promoters grow their channels through structured referral campaigns at scale.

name: Wallnuts
description: A solo-built crypto payment gateway proving a single developer can run their own payment infrastructure.
story: Intrigued by the idea that a single developer could run their own crypto payment gateway — so I designed and built one from the ground up. Handles wallet generation, transaction monitoring, and webhook callbacks.

name: livescores-scrapper-api
description: A small PHP library that exposes an endpoint for fetching live football score results.
story: A lightweight PHP library that scrapes live football scores and exposes them through a clean REST API. Built for fun and educational purposes — with Redis caching and Docker for easy self-hosting.

name: 3D Food Menu
description: An immersive 3D food menu experience that lets customers explore and visualize dishes in stunning detail before ordering.
story: Wanted people to see the food and salivate before ordering — so I built an interactive 3D menu powered by Three.js. Diners can spin, zoom, and explore every dish from every angle, turning online ordering into an experience rather than a transaction.

name: GovWatch
story: Built for the Civic Connect Hackathon 2025 — Abia State Government. A dual-channel citizen complaint platform with both web and USSD access so every demographic can reach the government. Didn't win, but the idea still stands.

name: bleon.net
story: Bleon is the studio my work ships under — CreditWithBleon first, MySales and LedgerCopilot since — and it needed a proper home: a page that says what the studio builds and how to work with it, in one scroll. Built it in 2023, clean and powerful.

name: MyCGPA Web (Legacy)
story: The original version of MyCGPA — a web app. My girlfriend was sad and crying about something, so I opened Figma to console her and we just started designing together. We built it out, showed it to our course advisor at uni, and it became real.

name: HappyMed AI
story: An AI-powered healthcare assistant built for the Klusterthon 2023 Hackathon by Stutern. Helps users understand symptoms and get preliminary medical guidance. Didn't win this one either — but shipped it.

name: Drape
description: Your wardrobe, digitized. Every piece you own in one place, a styling studio to try outfits before you dress, and looks you can build in seconds and share.
story: I kept buying things I already had. Drape photographs the closet once and keeps it in your pocket: every piece tagged and in its place, a styling studio that puts pieces together before you get dressed, and saved looks you can share with anyone. Expo on the phone, NestJS behind it. The store screenshots are done; the listing is next.

name: CLHEEAN
description: The National Orientation Agency's civic education app — a community forum, civic knowledge quizzes and ReportIT for reporting issues — on the Play Store and the App Store.
story: I didn't build this one; I shipped it. NOA handed me the finished source and asked for it on both stores. My part was the release: wrapping the web app for Android and iOS with Capacitor, building the APK and the IPA, and taking it through Play Console and App Store review, published under the agency's own name.

name: Studio
description: Video automation from a phone: a topic becomes a script and storyboard, the scenes get generated, you review and rearrange them, and it renders and publishes.
story: Making a YouTube video is mostly waiting between steps. Studio chains them: type an idea, get a script and storyboard, generate the scenes, drag them into the order you want, approve, render, publish. fal.ai draws, Claude and OpenAI write, a NestJS API holds it together. Still in development — nothing released yet.

name: Clear Status
description: A WhatsApp bot that gives you back HD video for Status. Send it a clip as a document, forward its reply to My Status, and the bytes reach your viewers untouched.
story: WhatsApp crushes every video posted to Status. Send Clear Status the clip as a document and it encodes it and sends the result back in chat; forward that message to My Status and WhatsApp reuses the media instead of compressing it again. Measured with VMAF on a 24.5-second iPhone clip: 74.86 posted from the gallery, 94.25 through the bot.

name: Shop AI
description: Let AI talk to your customers: a WhatsApp sales assistant that answers from the inventory a shop already keeps in a Google Sheet.
story: Small shops answer the same questions on WhatsApp all day — do you have it, how much, is it in stock. Shop AI puts a language model on the number: the inventory stays in the Google Sheet the owner already keeps, the model reads from it, and customers just chat. NestJS underneath.

name: Hermes Workflow Plugin
description: A workflow engine for the Hermes agent: scheduled, cron-like workflows with persistent per-workflow state and human-in-the-loop steps, created by people or by agents.
story: Agents are good at doing a thing once and bad at doing it every Monday. This plugin gives Hermes a first-class idea of a workflow: a schedule, state that survives between runs, and steps that stop and wait for a person before carrying on. Open source.

name: Open Hymnal JSON
description: A community-driven collection of church hymns as JSON, for anyone building a digital worship app.
story: The data behind Watchman Hymns, opened up. Every church app types the same hymn book out again from scratch; this is one structured collection anyone can build on. It is also the most-starred thing I have on GitHub, which says something about how many people needed it.

name: Ileke
description: Design your own crystal bracelet in the browser — pick the stones, spell a name, add a charm — with the price and wrist fit updating live. Paid in naira, strung by hand, delivered nationwide.
story: Ileke is Yoruba for beads. It's the design-it-yourself bracelet store, made for Nigeria: 144 stones to choose from, an encyclopedia of what each one is worn for, live pricing and wrist sizing as you build, and naira checkout through Bachs. Every order is strung by hand and delivered across the country.

name: Chidinma Onyia — Portfolio
description: A photography and film portfolio built on one idea: a single "register" drives every visual property of the page, so music videos, brand work and documentary each get a look of their own.
story: Three bodies of work that do not look alike, and should not. The site keeps one piece of state — the register — and derives the colour, the type and the grade from it, so moving from music videos to documentary re-skins the whole page. TanStack Start on the front, Payload as the CMS she edits herself.

name: The Cone Agency
description: The site for a video content and automation agency: turn attention into customers.
story: A landing page for The Cone Agency — video content, AI agents and automation for businesses that want more leads. Next.js, one page, one job: get the visitor to book a strategy call.
